findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compare_mortgage_scenarios, calculate_qualification, calculate_debt_service, calculate_ltv, estimate_prepayment_penalty · Private data: refuse_unsupported_mortgage_request, compare_mortgage_scenarios, calculate_qualification, calculate_debt_service, calculate_ltv, estimate_prepayment_penalty · Public sink: refuse_unsupported_mortgage_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compare_mortgage_scenarios, calculate_qualification, calculate_debt_service, calculate_ltv, estimate_prepayment_penalty · Private data: refuse_unsupported_mortgage_request, compare_mortgage_scenarios, calculate_qualification, calculate_debt_service, calculate_ltv, estimate_prepayment_penalty · Public sink: refuse_unsupported_mortgage_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
